Prototype 3 encodes W (98% pure) primarily through EEG (70%), with EOG (17%) and EMG (13%) contribution.
Its EEG signature shows absence of β_l (+7.4 dB, sensitivity=3.6) and absence of β_h (+11.1 dB, sensitivity=2.8).
The β_l activity is present in 100% of each epoch (sustained), with active eye movements (Blink 100% active) and intermediate muscle tone.
This is partially coherent with W physiology: confirmed: EMG tonic, EOG active; missing: α elevated+relevant.
